limitations: No public labelled ASIC failure dataset exists; this is a transparent rule, not a trained model.

maintenance_sources.excerpt: ASIC miner reported one fan at 0 rpm and chip temperature 92 C; the unit throttled to about 150 TH/s. Replaced the fan, about $35 and 20 min. Hashrate back to rated within 10 minutes.
Dust buildup on miner intake; chip temperature creeping up to 84 C and fan speed at maximum. Cleaned with compressed air, 10 min, no parts. Preventive cleaning avoided a hashboard failure.
